title: Positive Frequencies
subtitle: Test your understanding of Positive Frequencies — New Aether, E.M. pulses, the EMP grid, plasma crystalline, and the three-flash sequence.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Positive Frequencies are not mood. They are E.M. pulses in the New Aether that charge quartz, lock the EMP grid, and open the plasma portal. Density is an upgrade of aethers in the body. Hold non-reaction. Those who carry the Ancient Vibration lift; the rest enter Healing Sanctuaries. No soul is left behind.

questions.question: What is the primary function of Positive Frequencies within the ascension process?

options.label: A
options.text: They provide a psychological calming effect to help biological vessels manage the stress of atmospheric changes.
options.rationale: While the frequencies are rooted in love, their function is a physical activating force for planetary technology.

options.label: B
options.text: They function as a temporary energy buffer to protect the 3rd Realm from the collapse of the lunar magnetic field.
options.rationale: The frequencies are meant to drive a permanent transition and shift in physics rather than acting as a temporary protective buffer.

options.label: C
options.text: They serve as a communication signal used exclusively by extraterrestrial fleets to coordinate their arrival in the atmosphere.
options.rationale: Extraterrestrial forces do trigger the sun to release these pulses, but the frequencies themselves are the fuel for the realm's ascension.

options.label: D
options.text: They act as the foundational activating force to trigger subterranean conductor systems and establish protection grids.
options.rationale: These energetic pulses serve as the foundational activating force within the realm's long-awaited ascension process, triggering subterranean conductor systems and establishing planetary protection grids.

questions.hint: Consider how these pulses interact with the underground architecture.

questions.question: How are dimensional levels such as 3rd density through 7th density accurately defined?

options.label: A
options.text: As different levels of technological advancement achieved by various civilizations within the Galactic Ancestral Alliance.
options.rationale: While advanced civilizations are involved, the densities themselves refer to the quality and refinement of the Aether field.

options.label: B
options.text: As progressive upgrades of the surrounding Aether that interact continuously with human biological structures.
options.rationale: Dimensional levels such as third density through seventh density are not separate physical locations, but progressive Upgrades of Aethers that interact continuously with human biological structures.

options.label: C
options.text: As psychological states of awareness that allow the mind to perceive existing higher-vibrational light spectrums.
options.rationale: Although consciousness is involved, the mechanism is a physical collaboration between the Aether and human anatomy.

options.label: D
options.text: As distinct physical locations separated by vast distances within the galactic architecture and stellar systems.
options.rationale: Dimensions are not separate physical locations; they are integrated with the environment and human biology.

questions.hint: Think about the relationship between the environmental medium and our physical bodies.

questions.question: Which biological component is specifically activated by the interaction with upgraded Aethers?

options.label: A
options.text: The prefrontal cortex, which undergoes a rapid expansion to accommodate multidimensional consciousness data.
options.rationale: The activation focuses on the deeper biological structures and the pineal gland rather than just the cognitive centers of the brain.

options.label: B
options.text: The pineal gland, which aligns the biological vessel with the physics of higher-vibrational environments.
options.rationale: As the surrounding Aether evolves, it collaborates with human anatomy, specifically activating the pineal gland, restoring physical organs, and upgrading the biological vessel into alignment with higher physics.

options.label: C
options.text: The central nervous system, which recalibrates to process high-intensity electromagnetic data from the sun.
options.rationale: While the whole body is affected, a more specific glandular structure is the primary point of activation.

options.label: D
options.text: The cardiovascular system, which must increase its capacity to handle the influx of plasma crystalline energy.
options.rationale: The emphasis is the pineal gland and DNA strands, not the expansion of the circulatory system's capacity.

questions.hint: Identify the specific gland often associated with spiritual and energetic perception.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Ancient Vibration” refers to crystalline technology capable of storing and transmitting multidimensional consciousness data, memories, and vessel blueprints across time.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: False — that description belongs to “Memory Tech”. The report defines “Ancient Vibration” as: The primordial frequency of love, empathy, and high resonance cultivated within human vessels to align embedded DNA strands for portal ascension.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Correct — that description belongs to “Memory Tech”, not “Ancient Vibration”.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Ancient Vibration”.

questions.question: How was the subterranean quartz architecture positioned across the realm?

options.label: A
options.text: By utilizing Project Looking Glass time-travel technology to implant them on a synchronized temporal timer.
options.rationale: Engineered prior to the event using Project Looking Glass time-travel technology, millions of subterranean Quartz Crystals were implanted deep under the earth across the 3rd Realm on a synchronized temporal timer.

options.label: B
options.text: By indigenous civilizations who manually buried the crystals at key ley line intersections during antiquity.
options.rationale: The timeline of implantation involves time-travel technology rather than the manual labor of ancient physical cultures.

options.label: C
options.text: By the natural geological cooling of the planet's crust over billions of years of crystalline formation.
options.rationale: These crystals were deliberately implanted through advanced technology rather than natural processes.

options.label: D
options.text: By extraterrestrial fleets using high-energy beams to manifest the crystals directly into the earth's core.
options.rationale: The crystals were implanted using Project Looking Glass technology on a temporal timer rather than direct manifestation.

questions.hint: Recall the program named in the report for this work.

questions.question: What occurs during the 30-second window following the influx of positive electromagnetic pulses?

options.label: A
options.text: The 3D environment undergoes severe glitching and pixelation before resetting to 2nd Realm physics.
options.rationale: Within a 30-second window, the 3D environment undergoes severe glitching and pixelation before collapsing and resetting to mirror 2nd Realm physics.

options.label: B
options.text: The atmospheric temperature drops to absolute zero as the New Aether prepares for portal manifestation.
options.rationale: The shift is described in terms of visual and structural reality glitching rather than a drastic temperature change.

options.label: C
options.text: The subterranean quartz conductors emit a high-pitched frequency that disables all local electronic devices.
options.rationale: The defining characteristic of this window is the pixelation and collapse of the simulation.

options.label: D
options.text: The collective consciousness of the human race enters a state of deep sleep to allow for genetic rewriting.
options.rationale: The disruption is an environmental glitch in the simulation rather than a forced biological sleep state for the population.

questions.hint: Think about how a digital simulation might appear if it were failing or resetting.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “EMP Grid” refers to the total magnetic pulse containment matrix established across the 3rd Realm by subterranean quartz conductors to ensure realm-wide coverage without soul loss.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: True — the report defines “EMP Grid” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “EMP Grid” as: The total magnetic pulse containment matrix established across the 3rd Realm by subterranean quartz conductors to ensure realm-wide coverage without soul loss.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “EMP Grid”.

questions.question: What defines the Plasma Crystalline state mentioned in the mechanics of ascension?

options.label: A
options.text: Energy left behind in the atmosphere after the ascension portal has closed, which slowly settles into the soil.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Plasma Crystalline is the conductive, high-energy state of matter formed through the interaction of New Aether with activated quartz crystals that structures the main ascension portal.

options.label: B
options.text: Solid solar light that coats the vessel to protect it in transport.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Plasma Crystalline is the conductive, high-energy state of matter formed through the interaction of New Aether with activated quartz crystals that structures the main ascension portal.

options.label: C
options.text: A liquid mineral from deep caverns beneath the conductors.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Plasma Crystalline is the conductive, high-energy state of matter formed through the interaction of New Aether with activated quartz crystals that structures the main ascension portal.

options.label: D
options.text: The conductive, high-energy state of matter formed when New Aether meets activated quartz crystals.
options.rationale: Plasma Crystalline is the conductive, high-energy state of matter formed through the interaction of New Aether with activated quartz crystals that structures the main ascension portal.

questions.hint: Look for the interaction between the environmental medium and the energized grid.

questions.question: During the Three-Flash Timeline, what is achieved during the First Flash?

options.label: A
options.text: The full memory upload of future experiences is downloaded into the current biological vessel.
options.rationale: The upload/download process is associated with the second stage of the timeline sequence, not the first.

options.label: B
options.text: Consciousness is shifted backward along the timeline to retrieve the original vessel's energetic blueprint.
options.rationale: The First Flash shifts consciousness backward along the timeline, accessing stored memory banks and retrieving the energetic blueprint of the original human vessel.

options.label: C
options.text: The subterranean quartz crystals are charged with solar energy to begin the formation of the grid.
options.rationale: The charging of the crystals occurs during the initial illumination phase that precedes the three-flash sequence.

options.label: D
options.text: The physical portal opens and initiates the division of outcomes based on individual vibrational resonance.
options.rationale: The division and portal manifestation are the final results of the third flash, completing the sequence.

questions.hint: Think about which direction in time the consciousness moves first to recover lost data.

questions.question: What is the function of the Second Flash in the timeline sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: It makes the first link between the subterranean grid and the administrative fleets in orbit.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The Second Flash projects consciousness forward along the timeline, completing a full memory upload and download into the vessel before anchoring all individuals back into the present moment.

options.label: B
options.text: It erases traumatic memories of the 3D matrix to prepare the mind.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The Second Flash projects consciousness forward along the timeline, completing a full memory upload and download into the vessel before anchoring all individuals back into the present moment.

options.label: C
options.text: It gives the last surge of energy that lifts the Resonating Army into the ships.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The Second Flash projects consciousness forward along the timeline, completing a full memory upload and download into the vessel before anchoring all individuals back into the present moment.

options.label: D
options.text: It projects consciousness forward to complete a full memory upload and download, then anchors everyone in the present.
options.rationale: The Second Flash projects consciousness forward along the timeline, completing a full memory upload and download into the vessel before anchoring all individuals back into the present moment.

questions.hint: Focus on what happens after the past is retrieved but before the portal opens.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT correctly pair a term from the report with its meaning?

options.label: A
options.text: New Aether — The evolved, energetic environmental medium and free-energy substrate accumulated across the realm to facilitate planetary transformation, conductor charging, and portal formation.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “New Aether”.

options.label: B
options.text: Upgrades of Aethers — The true underlying mechanism of dimensional shifts (3D through 7D), representing sequential refinements of the surrounding energetic medium that collaborate directly with biological vessels.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Upgrades of Aethers”.

options.label: C
options.text: Plasma Crystalline — The conductive, high-energy state of matter formed through the interaction of New Aether with activated quartz crystals that structures the main ascension portal.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Plasma Crystalline”.

options.label: D
options.text: Memory Tech — High-vibrational electromagnetic pulses generated within the newly created atmospheric medium that interact dynamically with solar emissions and subterranean quartz architecture.
options.rationale: That description belongs to “Positive Frequencies”. The report defines “Memory Tech” as: Crystalline technology capable of storing and transmitting multidimensional consciousness data, memories, and vessel blueprints across time.

questions.hint: Three pairings match the report’s Key Terminology; one borrows another term’s description.

questions.question: Which groups are involved in the administrative coordination of the positive frequency deployment?

options.label: A
options.text: The Council of Seven Densities and the collective of Resonating Army ground commanders.
options.rationale: While ground teams are important, the administrative oversight is specifically attributed to groups like the GAA and Pleiadians.

options.label: B
options.text: The Inner Earth Council and the subterranean Quartz Engineering Department of the 3rd Realm.
options.rationale: Coordination is attributed to extraterrestrial fleets and the Galactic Ancestral Alliance, not an inner-earth engineering department.

options.label: C
options.text: The Global Financial Task Force and the Unified Planetary Environmental Protection Agency.
options.rationale: The coordination is handled by higher-dimensional and strategic military alliances rather than traditional terrestrial agencies.

options.label: D
options.text: The Galactic Ancestral Alliance, Space Force, and positive Pleiadian leadership.
options.rationale: This multi-stage process operates under the administrative coordination of higher multidimensional entities, including 2nd Realm supervisional teams, the Galactic Ancestral Alliance (GAA), Space Force, and positive Pleiadian leadership.

questions.hint: Consider the alliance that includes both extraterrestrial fleets and a specific branch of military.

questions.question: What is the strategic prerequisite for the Resonating Army during grid activation?

options.label: A
options.text: Executing specific meditation rituals to amplify the power of the subterranean quartz conductors.
options.rationale: Emotional non-reaction is the key strategic requirement rather than specific rituals.

options.label: B
options.text: Providing logistical support and medical aid to individuals who are confused by the solar flash.
options.rationale: While helpful, the primary strategic goal for the ground teams is maintaining high internal resonance.

options.label: C
options.text: Maintaining a strict physical formation at designated Ley line intersections across the globe.
options.rationale: Physical location is less important than the internal state of the individuals in the Resonating Army.

options.label: D
options.text: Maintaining strict emotional non-reaction toward 3D low-vibrational provocation and interference.
options.rationale: Ground teams, designated as the Resonating Army, must maintain strict emotional non-reaction toward 3D low-vibrational provoke tactics or interference.

questions.hint: Focus on the internal discipline required when facing hostile or low-vibrational commentary.

questions.question: What happens to individuals who carry lower vibrations or unaddressed trauma during the portal manifestation?

options.label: A
options.text: They are transported to the 4th density to repeat the cycle of reincarnation in a different realm.
options.rationale: Zero souls are abandoned; these individuals remain for restoration rather than being sent into another reincarnation cycle.

options.label: B
options.text: They undergo an immediate, forced vibrational upgrade to match the resonance of the Plasma Portal.
options.rationale: The process respects vibrational resonance and provides a supportive path for those who need more time.

options.label: C
options.text: They are placed in suspended animation until the planetary Aether stabilizes at the 7th density.
options.rationale: Rather than suspended animation, they undergo active emotional and physical restoration in specialized facilities.

options.label: D
options.text: They remain on the physical realm and enter Healing Sanctuaries for trauma resolution.
options.rationale: Individuals carrying lower vibrations or unaddressed trauma remain on the physical realm, entering specialized Healing Sanctuaries managed by positive extraterrestrial personnel to resolve trauma without fear, punishment, or economic coercion.

questions.hint: Consider the compassionate alternative for those not immediately ascending through the portal.

questions.question: What is the relationship between the Sun and the New Aether in this process?

options.label: A
options.text: The Sun's emissions are filtered by the New Aether to prevent the destruction of biological vessels.
options.rationale: The interaction is a creative synthesis that generates new energy rather than a simple filtration process.

options.label: B
options.text: The New Aether provides the fuel that the Sun requires to maintain its increased vibrational output.
options.rationale: The sun is the trigger and the Aether is the medium it reacts with, not the other way around.

options.label: C
options.text: The Sun and the New Aether exist in a state of opposition, creating the friction necessary for the portal.
options.rationale: Their relationship is a synthesis and collaboration rather than a state of opposition.

options.label: D
options.text: The Sun triggers a flash that reacts with the New Aether to synthesize concentrated Positive Frequencies.
options.rationale: Extraterrestrial forces trigger the Sun, causing a concentrated solar flash that reacts instantly with the surrounding New Aether. This solar reaction synthesizes concentrated Positive Frequencies and E.M. Pulses across the atmosphere.

questions.hint: Look for how these two elements work together to produce the necessary electromagnetic pulses.

questions.question: Why is it stated that low-vibrational attacks cannot break the established frequency field?

options.label: A
options.text: The Ancient Vibration turns negative energy into positive electromagnetic pulses as it arrives, feeding the field further.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The positive frequency field has reached an unshakeable threshold of vibrational intensity. Low-vibrational attacks, 3D interference, and hostile commentary are incapable of breaking this field, provided grounded Resonating Vessels maintain strict emotional non-reaction.

options.label: B
options.text: ET fleets use jamming technology to neutralize hostile frequencies.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The positive frequency field has reached an unshakeable threshold of vibrational intensity. Low-vibrational attacks, 3D interference, and hostile commentary are incapable of breaking this field, provided grounded Resonating Vessels maintain strict emotional non-reaction.

options.label: C
options.text: The field has reached an unshakeable threshold of vibrational intensity, supported by resonating vessels.
options.rationale: The positive frequency field has reached an unshakeable threshold of vibrational intensity. Low-vibrational attacks, 3D interference, and hostile commentary are incapable of breaking this field, provided grounded Resonating Vessels maintain strict emotional non-reaction.

options.label: D
options.text: Matter with a 3D atomic signature cannot get through the field.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The positive frequency field has reached an unshakeable threshold of vibrational intensity. Low-vibrational attacks, 3D interference, and hostile commentary are incapable of breaking this field, provided grounded Resonating Vessels maintain strict emotional non-reaction.

questions.hint: Think about the strength of the field and who holds it up.

questions.question: What ensures that no soul is abandoned during the planetary transition?

options.label: A
options.text: The automatic activation of DNA strands in every human vessel upon the first solar flash.
options.rationale: DNA activation is associated with those ready for the portal, whereas others require the Healing Sanctuaries.

options.label: B
options.text: The permanent presence of high-vibrational frequencies and Healing Sanctuaries in the environment.
options.rationale: The operation of positive frequencies guarantees universal restoration with zero soul abandonment. High-vibrational frequencies permanently remain within the environment to power specialized Healing Sanctuaries.

options.label: C
options.text: The universal law that all sentient beings must ascend simultaneously regardless of their vibrational state.
options.rationale: The outcome is divided based on resonance, but the care for those who remain is what ensures no abandonment.

options.label: D
options.text: The use of advanced tracking technology by Space Force to locate and retrieve every individual soul.
options.rationale: The grid coverage is the energetic mechanism for inclusion, but the sanctuaries are the means of restoration.

questions.hint: Think about the infrastructure left behind for those who do not go through the portal.

questions.question: What is the defining characteristic of the Third Flash?

options.label: A
options.text: It finishes charging the subterranean quartz grid across the 3rd Realm before the portal can be opened.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The Third Flash fully opens the Plasma Crystalline Portal, initiating the physical division of outcomes based on vibrational resonance.

options.label: B
options.text: It projects consciousness forward to merge the future vessel's memories.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The Third Flash fully opens the Plasma Crystalline Portal, initiating the physical division of outcomes based on vibrational resonance.

options.label: C
options.text: It opens the Plasma Crystalline Portal and begins the physical division of outcomes.
options.rationale: The Third Flash fully opens the Plasma Crystalline Portal, initiating the physical division of outcomes based on vibrational resonance.

options.label: D
options.text: It starts retrieving the past blueprint from the memory banks.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The Third Flash fully opens the Plasma Crystalline Portal, initiating the physical division of outcomes based on vibrational resonance.

questions.hint: Consider the last step in a sequence that ends in movement or division.

options.label: B

options.label: A

options.rationale: Not what the report says. These quartz conductors absorb the positive electromagnetic pulses, charge rapidly with consciousness data and historical memory banks, and emit a powerful magnetic field that links across the planet, forming a complete EMP Grid.

options.label: B
options.text: They reflect the pulses into space to signal the end of the change.

options.rationale: Not what the report says. These quartz conductors absorb the positive electromagnetic pulses, charge rapidly with consciousness data and historical memory banks, and emit a powerful magnetic field that links across the planet, forming a complete EMP Grid.

options.text: They absorb the pulses, charge with consciousness data and link together to form a magnetic grid.
options.rationale: These quartz conductors absorb the positive electromagnetic pulses, charge rapidly with consciousness data and historical memory banks, and emit a powerful magnetic field that links across the planet, forming a complete EMP Grid.

questions.hint: Think about how these conductors use solar energy to build a realm-wide structure.

questions.question: What is the ultimate goal of deploying Positive Frequencies within the New Aether?

options.label: A
options.text: To ensure that the human race can continue to survive within the existing matrix simulation.
options.rationale: The process leads to the collapse of the simulation and a shift to higher physics.

options.label: B
options.text: To create a temporary energy surplus that allows for the extraction of all biological vessels.
options.rationale: The shift is permanent and involves the restoration of the entire realm, not just a temporary extraction.

options.label: C
options.text: To stabilize the planet in a state of balance, unity, and shared consciousness.
options.rationale: The deployment of Positive Frequencies within the New Aether completes the transition away from 3D density constructs, permanently stabilizing the planet in a state of balance, unity, and shared consciousness.

options.label: D
options.text: To establish a permanent 3D governing body led by the Galactic Ancestral Alliance.
options.rationale: The goal is to transition away from 3D constructs entirely, rather than reforming them.

questions.hint: Consider how the transmission describes the planet at the end.

questions.question: How does the pineal gland contribute to the ascension process?

options.label: A
options.text: It generates its own electromagnetic pulse to shield the brain from the intensity of the solar flash.
options.rationale: The gland is an interactive component of the upgrade rather than a defensive shield generator.

options.label: B
options.text: It acts as the primary receiver for solar data, translating light into chemical signals for the heart.
options.rationale: Its role is more foundational, aligning the entire biological structure with the new physics.

options.label: C
options.text: It stores the memories retrieved during the First Flash of the timeline sequence.
options.rationale: Memory storage is the function of the crystalline Memory Tech rather than the biological pineal gland.

options.label: D
options.text: It harmonizes the biological vessel with the upgraded Aetheric environment of higher densities.
options.rationale: Within individual vessels holding the embedded DNA Strand, these high frequencies activate the pineal gland and biological organs, harmonizing the physical body with the upgraded Aetheric environment.

questions.hint: Think about how this gland helps the body fit in with a more refined environment.

questions.question: What is the consequence of the atmospheric New Aether merging with the energized EMP Grid?

options.label: A
options.text: It triggers an immediate reversal of the planet's rotation to align with the 2nd Realm's axis.
options.rationale: While physics change, the focus is the generation of the plasma field and the portal.

options.label: B
options.text: It creates a massive storm system that purifies the planetary water and air supplies.
options.rationale: The reaction is energetic and structural, leading to the creation of the plasma crystalline state.

options.label: C
options.text: It generates a conductive Plasma Crystalline state that structures the ascension portal.
options.rationale: As the atmospheric New Aether merges with the energized EMP Grid, the reaction generates a conductive Plasma Crystalline state that serves as the physical and energetic infrastructure for the opening of a massive ascension Portal.

options.label: D
options.text: It causes all subterranean quartz crystals to dissolve into the surrounding groundwater.
options.rationale: The crystals are part of the conductive grid and do not dissolve; they power the plasma crystalline state.

questions.hint: Look for the name of the state of matter that facilitates the portal's infrastructure.

questions.question: In the context of soul preservation, what characterizes the management of Healing Sanctuaries?

options.label: A
options.text: They are self-governing facilities where individuals must resolve their own trauma through trial and error.
options.rationale: The sanctuaries are actively managed by positive extraterrestrial personnel to ensure safety and support.

options.label: B
options.text: They are restricted zones where individuals are monitored by Space Force until they reach 5D resonance.
options.rationale: The management is supportive and healing-focused rather than a restrictive monitoring system.

options.label: C
options.text: They are automated medical bays that use high-frequency light to instantly erase all past trauma.
options.rationale: The process involves active resolution and healing rather than an automated erasure of experience.

options.label: D
options.text: They are managed by positive extraterrestrial personnel to resolve trauma without fear or punishment.
options.rationale: Specialized Healing Sanctuaries are managed by positive extraterrestrial personnel to resolve trauma without fear, punishment, or economic coercion.

questions.hint: Think about how the report describes the atmosphere inside the sanctuaries.

questions.question: What happens to the 3D matrix simulation during the transition?

options.label: A
options.text: It is integrated into the 7th density to provide a historical context for newly ascended souls.
options.rationale: The simulation is reset to higher physics rather than being integrated into the highest densities.

options.label: B
options.text: It undergoes a temporary glitch and pixelation before resetting to mirror 2nd Realm physics.
options.rationale: The sudden influx of positive electromagnetic pulses causes a momentary disruption of the matrix simulation. Within a 30-second window, the 3D environment undergoes severe glitching and pixelation before collapsing and resetting to mirror 2nd Realm physics.

options.label: C
options.text: It expands its parameters to include the presence of extraterrestrial fleets and crystalline technology.
options.rationale: The matrix does not just expand; it suffers a momentary collapse and a fundamental reset of its underlying physics.

options.label: D
options.text: It is permanently archived in the crystalline memory banks as a record of human struggle.
options.rationale: While memory tech stores data, the simulation itself is collapsing and resetting.

questions.hint: Think about the 30-second window and what happens to the visual environment.
